services.name: Page review and approval workflow
services.scope: Remove the replicate right from your client's author groups so their publish requests from the Sites console start the request workflow, and customize it with review, legal or safety sign-off and approval steps assigned to groups, plus an urgent out-of-hours route. Keep the workflows non-transient so their history is saved, create a page version at each publish, and keep that history and those versions for the agreed retention period, with workflow purging set to match.
services.adobe_quote: A workflow is triggered to notify the appropriate person of your request to publish. This workflow may have been customized by your development team.

source.title: Experience League: Publishing Pages from the Sites Console

product_facts: AEM Sites as a Cloud Service is built on Adobe's Core Components and page templates, with code deployed through Cloud Manager and pages edited visually in the Universal Editor.
AEM Sites is where the site is built, on Adobe's Core Components and page templates, and where your authors edit its pages.
We would implement AEM Sites as a Cloud Service. Code is deployed through Cloud Manager, Adobe's one route for it, so every release passes the same code quality checks.
We would start with discovery: a review of your current site's content, templates and integrations, a named team with agreed roles, and the measures of success.

How your existing content moves depends on where it sits today. From an existing AEM instance, Adobe's Content Transfer Tool moves it across. From another CMS, we would export the content, map it to the new templates and load it into AEM, agreeing the mapping and tooling with you in discovery.

For go-live we would plan a content freeze for the final content top-up, check the migrated content with you, test in the stage environment, which has the same sizing as production, and run user acceptance testing on a test subdomain before the DNS cutover, with redirects for retired URLs and rollback criteria agreed beforehand.
Remove the right to the replicate action from all appropriate users for all relevant pages.

If the work item was assigned to a group, the group members are available. If the work item was assigned to a group and then delegated to a user, the group members and the group are available. If the work item was assigned to a single user, the work item cannot be delegated.
Note that no information will be shown for transient workflows as no history information is saved for these.

Whether a new page version is created upon publish is determined by the location from where you trigger the publish event. To ensure a new version is always created you can use a Cloud Manager Environment variable.
Configure Adobe Granite Workflow Purge Configuration to purge workflow instances according to their age and status.

services.name: Language copies and local corrections across markets
services.scope: Plan your client's language masters and the country sites sharing each language, integrate their translation service provider with AEM and run the first translation projects, reviewing updated translations in a launch. Deploy the blueprint configuration through the CI/CD pipeline, create each country site as an MSM Live Copy of its language master and set the rollout configurations. Agree which components each market may correct locally by breaking their inheritance, and test that a later central update reaches a shared page without overwriting its correction.
services.adobe_quote: Use MSM to create country sites from the translated language masters and to roll out content to sites sharing the same language.

services.name: Nightly ERP or PIM data into AEM pages
services.scope: Build a Content Fragment Model holding only the product fields agreed for the public site, never prices or stock, and show each fragment on its product page with the Content Fragment Component. Build an App Builder application that a cron job runs each night to check your client's ERP or PIM file and write each passing file to AEM Author through the Content Fragment Management API. Hold a late, incomplete or conflicting file so the published values stay live, and report each run to your client's product data owner, who publishes the updated fragments from the console.
services.adobe_quote: Common API use cases involve integrations with systems such as a CRM or PIM, where AEM APIs are invoked to retrieve or persist data.

services.name: Content migration from another CMS
services.scope: Where your client is moving from a CMS other than AEM: inventory the current site with your client, agree which pages to retain, merge or retire, and map each content type to the new site's templates and components. Script the import that builds each retained page on its template, load the pages as content packages through Package Manager, bring their images and files in with Bulk Import, and publish them. Redirect every retired, merged or moved URL through a pipeline-free rewrite map or Dispatcher or CDN rules, and test that old URLs and inbound links reach the agreed pages.

services.name: Document versions, expiry and replacement on published pages
services.scope: Set an expiration date in the Expires field on each document your client withdraws or limits in time, so users without administrator permissions cannot publish it and the background job that runs every day at midnight by default removes it from Publish; unpublish at once any document that cannot wait for that run. Where your client's teams use the Experience Manager desktop app or Adobe Asset Link, apply the setting that keeps expired assets out of browsing and search there too. Upload each approved replacement under the existing asset's name and folder and keep it as a new version, check the pages its References tab lists before publishing, and if the replacement is wrong, revert to the previous version in the Timeline and publish it again.
services.adobe_quote: Uploading an asset with the same path ... as an existing asset triggers a warning dialog that presents three resolution options ... A new version of the existing asset is created in the repository, preserving the earlier state so no work is lost. You can view the two versions in the Timeline and can revert to the previously existing version if necessary.
services.license: AEM Sites for the pages that use the documents

source.title: Experience League: Add digital assets to Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service Assets

product_facts: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service is Adobe's cloud-native solution for digital asset management and Dynamic Media. It helps you maximize the value of your digital assets across creation, management and delivery.
AEM Assets is the repository where your digital assets are managed, enriched and delivered.

To bring your existing library across, Bulk Import lets administrators import large numbers of assets directly from an external data source in a single operation. AEM applies smart tags to uploaded assets automatically, by default.

People find the right asset through smart tags, customized metadata and enhanced search. Metadata forms let you add your own business-specific fields to an asset's details page, and we would agree those fields with you before the assets are loaded.
For distribution, Content Hub centralizes and distributes approved brand and marketing content. Only assets marked Approved in AEM Assets become available there.
Asset reports show how the system is used, how users interact with assets and which assets are shared.

Once applied, expired assets are excluded from browsing, search, and fetch operations across the desktop app and Adobe Asset Link, matching the behavior already present in the Experience Manager user interface.

Once an asset expires, a user without administrator permissions cannot edit, copy, move, publish, or download the expired asset. ... In the Advanced tab, set an expiration date for the asset from the Expires field. This ensures the asset is automatically flagged once it is no longer valid for use.
A background job named com.day.cq.dam.core.impl.ExpiryNotificationJobImpl removes expired assets from Publish and Dynamic Media Scene7. This job runs every day at midnight by default
Select the Publish or Unpublish option as required. ... Select Now to act on the asset immediately.

Adobe Experience Manager enables Digital Asset Management (DAM) users to check all references to an asset across webpages. The References tab in an asset’s Properties page lists both the local and remote references of the asset, providing a single, consolidated view of where the asset is used.

services.name: Email program and preference migration from another platform
services.scope: Inventory your client's active email programs, subscription types and suppression records, and agree which choice wins when sources or the CRM conflict. Import the people and their choices into Marketo Engage, set Unsubscribed, Marketing Suspended or Blocklisted with Change Data Value flow steps, so an unsubscribe covers every record with the same email address, and mark addresses that hard bounced on the old platform as Email Invalid. Set up the subscription center, rebuild the active programs with no marketing email set as operational, and check the first migrated send's blocked people and that no suppressed address is among its recipients.
services.adobe_quote: Blocked people in the Marketo Engage database are marked blocklisted, unsubscribed, marketing suspended, or have an invalid or empty email.
services.license: exports of people, subscription choices and suppression records from the current email platform

source.title: Experience League: View Blocked People in a Smart Campaign

product_facts: There are two documented routes. The simpler one: forms built in Marketo Engage are embedded on the site's pages with Marketo's own embed code, so each submission is a Marketo form fill. We would place the embed in a reusable page component, agree the fields, consent wording and validation with you, and collect only the data you approve. Marketo's form prefill does not work with the embed code.

The fuller one: AEM Forms adaptive forms with the Submit to Marketo Engage action, which add a rule editor, prefill and a PDF record of each submission, and can connect to Adobe Sign for e-signatures. We would use embedded Marketo forms for standard lead capture and adaptive forms where a form needs that logic.
Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform, a single solution that lets you attract, segment and nurture your customers. Each marketing initiative runs as a program.
Marketo Engage runs the marketing programs that attract, segment and nurture your customers.

We would configure the admin settings, including CNAMEs and Marketo's JavaScript tracking code, Munchkin, which tracks the people who visit your website so that automated campaigns can react to their visits. We would test the automation workflows and the data sync before launch.
Campaigns run as Smart Campaigns. A Smart List defines who you want to target, using filters and triggers, and the flow sets the steps the campaign performs, including wait steps and split choices.
All of these fields are built-in to your Marketo subscription. They are all boolean (checkbox) type. They can be used in Forms or Change Data Value flow steps.
If the unsubscribe flag is set from false to true, the master email status is updated, and the change is propagated to other people with the same email address.
If you are using custom fields and don’t see them in the drop-down, go back and create them so they can become options.

A Marketo-hosted landing page that allows email recipients to manage their subscription preferences, choosing which types of communications they want to receive or opting out of specific categories rather than fully unsubscribing.

An email that ignores Unsubscribed and Marketing Suspended status. Meant to be used for critical or auto-response emails. Not meant for marketing. Operational emails will not to be sent to people with Blocklisted or Email Invalid status.
